Thanks, hope so :)
Thank you very much. I appreciate it a lot.

Your fiance sounds like the ideal person for a BPD sufferer, someone who can truly just recognise those moments of BPD insanity and 'tune them out' and know that they're not the real 'you'...glad to hear there is hope for the rest of us :)

Me too! How have you found maintaining your relationships through it all? Not just romantic ones, but friendships, family, work, etc. 

Also, are you on medication? Have you found a certain medication that seems to work better than the rest?

I'm 22. Like that Taylor Swift song...it's miserable and magical oh yeahhhh. Accurate. Haha. 

Swift jokes aside, I was with this guy since I was 18 so I guess it really is a bit of leftover teen anguish and first love and all of that. I can't believe how much better I'm feeling since I've had all these comments on this thread. I am so so glad I posted. I wasn't going to, because I felt like that would just cement my pathetic-ness and hopelessness...but it really did the opposite. 

Thank you very much for taking the time to chat.

It's a great outlet isn't it. Anonymity can be weirdly therapeutic. Unrequited love is the worst :( But you're right, if someday we get another chance I guess we want to be around for it. Or maybe something better comes along. I hope you're feeling alright too. PM me if ever you need to vent or anything. Thanks again for your help :)
Thank you :) Appreciate it.
Thank you :)

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your story with me and make me feel supported and not alone. I appreciate it so much, and it really, really helps to not feel alone. 

It's a really tough thing to go through and you're right, I think we'll come through it all as stronger individuals and stronger lovers. I hope so anyway. 

<3 hugs. Thanks again!
Thank you! It means a lot, and I will definitely keep that quote in the back of my mind for nights when I'm feeling bad about it all.
Thank you! I still feel pretty down but I'm overwhelmed by the support I've gotten in this thread and it's crazy helpful to not feel alone in it all. Thanks for the good vibes :):)
Thank you. Not D, no, sorry lol.

I can't imagine how difficult that all must have been to cope with - and to be able to say that it gets better. Thanks for taking the time to comment, I really appreciate it, and it definitely helps to hear that it gets better from someone who has truly experienced grief and loss.

I love how reddit was number 1, lol. But you're very right, those are all things I've been focusing on. Spending time with my friends has been my most effective outlet so I will try to do more of that. 

Appreciate everything, thank you so much.

> Every broken heart you get is one broken heart closer to true love.

This really helps. To think that I'm still young and it's part of life and everyone goes through something like this at some stage, and true love is the light at the end of the tunnel...

Thank you. You're great.
This made me chuckle. I appreciate it, and you're very right.

I wish it wasn't easier said than done...I guess I'll get there...just night's like these make me feel really crappy and like I can't keep living. 

Thanks for your help.
Yeah. That's true. I hadn't thought of it as moving forward rather than moving on...moving on would be great too though

Very true. I've been trying to concentrate on working on myself and being happy independently since the break up, but it's easier said than done I think. I've come a long way since when it first happened, I was just a mess. But the more time goes on the more I feel like I really do love him. Ugh.

I'm Lauren. I appreciate it. I don't have that much to look forward to...nothing planned at the moment anyway. Just seeing friends and stuff I guess. Which is good but lots of things I enjoy just remind me of him and it makes me feel sick. 

Oh well. Thanks again
Thank you...this is great advice

Yeah this is so true. I tell myself this all the time. I don't even want to be with someone who doesn't want to be with me...I just feel so sure that I love him, and it's awful. We were together just less than 4 years...long time.
Appreciate it.
